semantic_review.rationale: French Polynesian five administrative subdivisions are archipelagos, not automatically local territories. Cook locations cover only 11 named islands; survey Suwarrow, Nassau and other published islands before approving completeness. Kiribati Line whole group requires island-level geographic purpose. Isolated Howland/Baker and Pitcairn repeated tiers require full named-island coverage, not distant atoll mergers.
